mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and a comfortable 73 degrees at Harriet Park, with a waning gibbous moon phase appearing lately.

The Verona Police Department reminds residents that crash reports and other official records are handled by their records section. You can obtain traffic accident forms online at crashdocs.org about 10 days after an incident, or request other documents through their office with a standard 10-day processing window.

We have plenty to look forward to, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow is packed with trivia options at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by the downtown farmers market and live music at Paddy Mac's on August 5.
Regarding the weekly police report, on July 23, officers were called to a residence on Lucerne Drive for a domestic disturbance, which resulted in the arrest of a 23-year-old local man.
Enjoy the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor today at Culver's, open until 10 PM. You can also find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 2 PM.
